about: The star chooser's Kinds (ED6 part 2, editing design section 9). A kind is a phase of a star's life, with the spectral letters it must show where that matters (the kernel's class, describe_star's now.class); the chooser finds the mass that is that kind at the system's present age on the kernel's life line (describe_star), so no mass or age is typed here. prefer_msun only picks among several masses that all qualify. Move these into the class atlas once it has star classes.
